newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CLABECQ TO OPEN 10% DOWN ON TUESDAY - BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: CLABECQ TO OPEN 10% DOWN ON TUESDAY - BOURSE.

text.p: Shares in Belgian steel maker Forges de Clabecq will be marked down 10 percent from Friday's 175 franc close at Tuesday's opening after only indicative prices were shown on Monday due to an excess of sellers, the Brussels bourse said.

Earlier an official for the European Commission said it planned to rule next week that a 1.5 billion francs capital injection for the steel maker amounted to state aid which is generally not allowed on competition grounds.
Clabecq is traded on the cash market where shares are normally subjected to two price fixings a day.
On Monday afternoon the share was showing bid and ask prices of just 10 francs.
"Because there are far more sellers than buyers and the (indicative) price is so low, the stock will open on Tuesday 10 percent below (Friday's) 175 franc level," a Brussels bourse spokesman said.
